billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Project value, payment schedule, invoices and payments received. Every figure comes from your invoices and the payments you record.
billing.restricted: Billing is visible to owners and admins.

schedule.title: Payment schedule
schedule.hint: Split the project value into terms. Percentages always refer to the whole value. Terms that already have an invoice are locked.
schedule.label: Term
schedule.empty: No terms yet. Add one, or save the value alone.
schedule.matches: Terms add up to the project value.
schedule.mismatch: Terms add up to {total}, the value is {value}.

terms.title: Ready to invoice
terms.hint: Terms from the schedule without an invoice. Creating one makes a draft with the term amount.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.hint: New invoices are drafts until you issue them. Issuing assigns a number and the due date. Overdue is shown automatically when the due date passes.
invoices.cancelBody: The invoice stays in the history as cancelled. Its schedule term can be invoiced again.

custom.title: Custom invoice
custom.hint: For work outside the schedule, such as a change request. It starts as a draft.

payment.title: Record payment
payment.hint: Enter money you already received, from your own records such as a bank statement or receipt.

ledger.title: Transaction history
ledger.hint: Payments are never deleted. A wrong entry is voided with a reason and stays visible.
ledger.voidBody: The payment stays in the history, struck through, and the invoice balance is recalculated.

errors.termsMismatch: The terms must add up to the project value.
errors.termInvoiced: This term already has an invoice.
errors.notDraft: Only draft invoices can be issued.
errors.notIssued: Issue the invoice before marking it sent.
errors.cannotCancel: Paid or cancelled invoices cannot be cancelled.
errors.hasPayments: Void the payments on this invoice before cancelling it.
errors.futureDate: The payment date cannot be in the future.
errors.notOpen: Payments can only be recorded on issued invoices.
errors.overpay: The amount is more than the balance due.
errors.currencyLocked: The currency cannot change once the project has invoices.

detail.draftNote: This is a draft. Issue it from the billing page before sending it to the client.

client.title: Client & billing
client.hint: Who the project is for, whether they can see it in the client portal, and the billing currency.
client.noClients: No clients yet. Add one from the clients page first.
client.portalHint: The client sees progress, shared documents, visible features and invoices. Requires a client.
client.currencyLocked: Locked because the project already has invoices.

share.label: Share with client
share.hint: Only approved documents can be shared.

scope.title: Features
scope.description: What is in and out of the agreed scope. Keep it current so everyone agrees on what is being built.
scope.clientNote: Clients see only the items marked visible, in the client portal.
scope.readOnly: You can view the scope. Editors and owners can change it.

categoryHints.excluded: Explicitly not part of this project.
categoryHints.optional: Can be added if agreed separately.

scope.deleteBody: "{title}" is removed from the scope. This cannot be undone.
scope.generated: {count, plural, =0 {No new features found in the requirements.} one {# feature added from the requirements.} other {# features added from the requirements.}}

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: The project progress as your client sees it, built from milestones and tasks.
progress.empty: No milestones yet. Create a plan to show progress.

editor.title: Client view of milestones
editor.hint: Choose which milestones the client sees and give them a plainer name. Hidden milestones still count toward the percentage.
